items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished game environment asset concept sheet for H01 HANGAR SOUTH APPROACH WALKWAY. Reference images show existing game's hangar and its actual FBM color atlas; use only as style/material reference, do not depict the hangar itself. Pearl white bevelled frame, lavender panel inserts, dark titanium underside, restrained cyan recessed guide lights, tiny amber caution accents. Friendly stylized hard-surface sci-fi on alien planet, matching references. Object: long straight level modular walkway 14.1m long, 2.8m wide, deck thickness 0.3m, clear pedestrian surface, shallow edge lips, inset panel seams, no tall railings or pillars. Front is entry at short end, rear is opposite short end; right and left are LONG side elevations. One landscape sheet with exactly SIX clearly separated panels in a 3-column by 2-row grid: CONCEPT (three-quarter hero), FRONT (orthographic end), RIGHT (orthographic long side), LEFT (opposite long side), TOP (orthographic plan), BACK (opposite end). Same exact object geometry and materials across all views. Neutral pale grey background, studio lighting, generous margins, full object visible in each cell, readable uppercase labels, title H01 SOUTH APPROACH WALKWAY. No environment in orthographic views, no people, no extra objects, no perspective in five orthographic panels. Detailed production concept art, not blueprint. Output high resolution.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE landscape game asset concept sheet. Reference images are style/material guides only, not edit targets. Match pearl white bevelled frames, lavender panels, dark titanium undersides, restrained cyan lights and tiny amber accents of existing Astra hangar. Friendly clean stylized sci-fi, soft studio light, pale grey background. Exactly six panels in 3 columns x2 rows: CONCEPT three-quarter hero, FRONT orthographic elevation, RIGHT orthographic elevation; LEFT orthographic elevation, TOP orthographic plan, BACK orthographic elevation. The FIVE elevations must use ZERO perspective, camera exactly level with object center, no looking down, no vanishing points; long thin objects should stay thin, not inflated to fill cells. Consistent identical geometry and details in every view. All views uncropped. Clear uppercase labels and sheet title. No characters or environment. Title: H02 EAST ENTRANCE LANDING. Object: Level rectangular entrance landing 3.5m wide x 9.5m long x 0.3m thick. Open transfer platform with white perimeter chamfers, lavender nonslip panels, cyan edge markers, short-end entry and side exit kept clear. No building, rails or stairs.
